title: Coast Guard rescues seven boaters near Great Inagua
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew rescues seven people Wednesday, Feb. 1, 2017 from the 180-foot motor vessel  Trois Rivieres taking on water about 46 miles west of Great Inagua, Bahamas. The helicopter hoisted all seven mariners and transferred them to Royal Bahamas Defense Force in Great Iguana. U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Clearwater.
